title: Rust Variables
learning_objectives: Distinguish immutable and mutable variable bindings.
Read compiler errors for invalid mutation attempts.
explanation: Variables are immutable by default in Rust. Use `mut` when a value must change over time.

examples.title: Immutable by default
Mutable binding

compiler_error_examples: error[E0384]: cannot assign twice to immutable variable
completion_criteria: Learner can explain when `mut` is required
